scope: Author-side optimized-behavior and portable-checkpoint follow-up; no browser work

profile_inspection.note: Cargo reports release [optimized]; no release debug-assertions/overflow-check override, RUSTFLAGS, CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS, or matching CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_* override was present. No profiles or toolchain defaults were changed.

source_review.conclusion: No correctness dependency on debug overflow checks or debug assertions found.
source_review.evidence: Integer operators use checked_add/sub/mul/div; division zero and unit mismatches return errors. Length conversion checks finite input/result and nonzero-to-zero range loss, multiplying by a fixed unit ratio first. Runtime boundary/CLI tests passed optimized.
source_review.bounded_plain_arithmetic: Unit ratios come from four fixed positive finite scales; workshop subtotal uses checked multiplication.

source_review.conclusion: All five arithmetic branches return explicit overflow errors in release.
source_review.evidence: checked_neg/add/sub/mul/div, private AST, parser source/token/depth limits; new test asserts each operator byte span and nearby representable boundary.
source_review.bounded_plain_arithmetic: Byte indices stay within 4096; token cursor within 512; precedence is 1 or 2; each depth/nesting increment is at most 65 before rejection, so usize/u8 overflow is unreachable through parsing.

source_review.conclusion: Rejected overflow preserves the complete state in release.
source_review.evidence: Checked sequence, accepted count and accumulated notional are calculated before state commits; new test injects each counter maximum and tests both a place and an existing-order cancellation. Existing accounting overflow test also passes.
source_review.bounded_plain_arithmetic: Validated price <= 10^12 ticks and quantity <= 10^9 make individual u128 product <= 10^21. Fraction padding never exceeds 9999. Synthetic indices <= 10,000,000 bound ordinary arithmetic. Digest wrapping multiplication is an explicit hash choice, not domain arithmetic.
source_review.debug_assertions: Only the benchmark executable and layout profiling example test cfg!(debug_assertions), to refuse timing in debug builds; no domain validation depends on it.

source_review.conclusion: Safe API invariants survive the optimized tests; unsafe soundness is not established by these tests alone.
source_review.evidence: Private initialized-prefix length remains <= N. push rejects full storage before increment; pop rejects empty storage before decrement; clear publishes empty before destructor calls. Seven release tests cover zero capacity, safe-baseline operation sequences, moves/drops, ZSTs, alignment, mutable access and one destructor panic.
source_review.bounded_plain_arithmetic: len < N before increment guarantees representability even for a hypothetical maximum usize capacity. Test PRNG wrapping is intentional. No debug assertions enforce initialization or capacity.

changes.gap_closed: Subtraction, multiplication, negation and MIN/-1 overflow had no dedicated operator-span boundary coverage; also check nonoverflowing neighboring extrema.
Sequence and accepted-counter overflow branches lacked complete-state rejection coverage for place and cancel; injected states are clearly labeled.

portability.full_dependency_resolution: 37 fresh standalone copies passed cargo metadata --offline --locked; local package manifests remained inside each copy; canonical lock bytes unchanged; all external versions/checksums were subsets of the corresponding reference lock.
portability.p11_lock_rule: P11 copies the Cargo.lock already present in its source instead of naming a separate manifest lockfile field. Both UI checkpoint graphs passed.
portability.archive_note: Snapshot predates the two test additions and this evidence. Root must package final source after integrating final evidence; manifest/lock compatibility was verified on the identified exact snapshot.

limitations: This is author-side verification, not independent acceptance or a measure of learner competence.
Finite test cases and code review do not prove all arithmetic/resource cases; P13 release tests supplement prior Miri evidence and its explicit safety reasoning, not replace them.
Counter maxima are injected privately in tests because executing 2^64 events is not feasible; accepted-count overflow is a defensive branch unreachable under the normal counter relation.
Default unwind behavior was tested, including one destructor panic; panic=abort and simultaneous destructor panics were not exercised.
Metadata validates graph resolution and path containment, not compilation of every reconstructed copy in this run; prior checkpoint compilation evidence remains separate.
No browser access or rendering verification occurred.
The shared native cache was reused. Source and raw metadata audit copies remain in the reported outer cache, not in the portable course.
